notes.title: New Update 1.11 is out now!
notes.content:
With this bigger update we want to announce the new fodder production feature and the support of Steam Workshop.

[b]Fodder Production[/b]
The fodder for your animals is no longer an inexhaustible resource! So your zoo keepers will run out of fodder as long as you do not produce enough fodder.
Therefore please check the new build options in the maintenance build menu. You will find new production buildings for each type of fodder.
 
[b]Steam Workshop[/b]
With the activated Steam Workshop feature you are now able to create your own maps and levels to share them with your friends and all other Steam users.
You can set up your own level objectives to offer new zoo theme challenges.
So feel free to check it out. The "Start Leveleditor" button will be enabled in the main menu now.

[b]7 New Animal Species[/b]
+Giant Tortoise
+Hyena
+Indian Blackbuck
+Kudu
+Lama
+Mandrill
+Okapi
 
[b]New Visitors[/b]
We included some more visitor types business men and business women.
 
[b]6 New Plants[/b]
+Apple tree
+Lavender
+Date palm
+Hydrangea
+Sunflowers
+Water lily
 
We also added more fences/walls, fixed some minor bugs and improved the balancing, i.e. decreased the animal prices and increased the visitor sight radius for decoration and plants.

Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Update 1.10 is out now!
notes.content:
Just in time for the Steam Summer Sales we gift you three brand new animals and two natural fodder resources.
Enjoy the [b]bongo [/b]antilope with its amazing striped fur, the fastest living mammal [b]cheetah[/b] and the master of mountain climbing, the [b]Ibex[/b].

Use the new park facilities anthill and mussel bed as natural fodder resource. They need no keepers to refill, but they do regenerate slowly.

By the way: This update fix some minor bugs and give you the ability to start new games with park level 5.

Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: "Frosty" Update 1.09
notes.content:
"Frosty" Update 1.09: New Boreal and Arctic Animals, New 4 Star Park Objectives
Features
- 5 new boreal and arctic animals (Arctic Hare, Arctic Fox, Canadian Lynx, Walrus and Seal)
- new park level 4 star objectives
- new build option snow
- Steam Cloud Save support
- additional account type for animal sales
- undo and redo buttons


Fixed Bugs / Balancing
- visitor running out of money lost indication fixed
- changed park level 3 objectives
- veterinary did not helped interacting animals fixed
- visitor need for plants reduced
- blocked staff by visitors fixed
- some minor bugs

Hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: Update Version 1.04: New animals, freak of nature animal variations and park facilities
notes.content:
New features:
- 2 more animal species ([b]King Penguin[/b] and [b]Oryx[/b])
- 14 animal species with [b]Freak Of Nature[/b] variation breedable (i.e. white tiger, black panther)
- Freak of Nature occurance (about 2% probability per birth) and inheritance rules implemented
- GUI modifications and control improvements (i.e. local grid visualization, plant deletion when building fences and pathways, animated load cursor, soilage renamed to green fodder, object info changes)
- new build options (like popcorn machine and more decoration/plants)
- improved gameplay balancing (i.e. pricing)

Fixed bugs:
- sporadic lost objectives problem fixed
- unappropriate "needs more space" message fixed
- remove problems with trees/trunks (lost invisible trunks)
- performance improvements
- some animal stuck problems fixed
- vet work priority problems fixed
- other minor bugs

notes.title: Update Version 1.02: New animal and ground textures
notes.content:
- An additional zoo residents: The one-hump [b]dromedary[/b]
- Redesigned [b]ground[/b]/water [b]textures[/b]: Higher resolution and more detail

Minor changes:
- Some animal animations emit particles
- Made dead animals and carcasses movable
- Vets treat life-threatening needs
- Build menu subcategory buttons redesigned
- Game version added to the main menu
- Enabled texture filtering for smoother ground textures

Fixed bugs:
- Keepers no longer get stuck underwater
- Animals can no longer die multiple times
- 3D Objects on ways no longer disappear
- Binoculars generate revenue now
- Fixed crash while loading after playing for a long time
- Fixed crash when creating a user with a long username
